name: Xie zhi Wei
source:
"Scorpion's Tail" is a AVG set in an alternate historical timeline. In the war-born nation of SouthXi, a conspiracy involving girls begins to surface.Investigator Zhang Cheng meets a mysterious girl. After accepting request, he is drawn into a web of secrets.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3585260]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《蝎子的尾巴》是一款以平行历史时间线为背景的AVG。在战火纷飞的南西国家，一场涉及女孩的阴谋开始浮出水面。调查员张成遇见了一位神秘女孩。接受请求后，他被卷入了一张秘密之网。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3585260]Steam[/url]]
